seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Bel Air, Maryland for 2026: 4 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Bel Air lights up historic downtown for Winter Wonderland, with Santa, carriage rides and free train rides, and it ends the first weekend of December with a parade and tree lighting.
celebrates: Downtown Bel Air celebrates under thousands of warm lights from November 28 to January 3, with the Bel Air Armory, the Harford County Courthouse and Bel Air Town Hall all lit. On three Saturdays the Town adds live music and carolers, Santa in front of the courthouse, complimentary carriage rides and free Winter Wonderland Express train rides at Old Fields Park. A free Christmas train garden sits in the back room of Main Street Tower, and the Bel Air Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting follows on Sunday, December 6.
lastyear: The Town of Bel Air's calendar shows Winter Wonderland on Saturday, December 13, 2025, centered on the Bel Air Armory, the Harford County Courthouse and Bel Air Town Hall. The 2026 parade is billed as the 36th annual Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting, which makes the 2025 parade the 35th. The Winter Wonderland in Bel Air Facebook page is the festival's own place for weekly updates.
facts: The 2026 Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting is the 36th annual one, according to the Town of Bel Air. The Christmas in Bel Air website, christmasinbelair.com, has its own page for the Winter Wonderland nights and also covers the parade and tree lighting. The Frederick Ward Armory Park stage hosts live music each Saturday evening, and a mural in historic downtown Bel Air, next to Main Street Tower, hosts a second set.
trains: Bel Air has its own train rides and a train garden. The Winter Wonderland Express carries families for free at Old Fields Park on November 28, December 5 and December 12, and the Christmas train garden in Main Street Tower is free on Fridays and Saturdays through December 19. For a bigger train outing, the National Museum of Railroad History and Innovation in Baltimore runs The Polar Express Train Ride at Christmas, and the Ma and Pa Railroad Heritage Village in Pennsylvania preserves a railroad village from about 1915.

faq: When is the Bel Air Christmas parade in 2026?

The 36th Annual Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting is Sunday, December 6, 2026, with the parade at 3:30 pm along Main Street and the tree lighting afterward. The Town of Bel Air lists it on its calendar, and Visit Harford shows the same date.
Where can kids meet Santa in Bel Air?

During Winter Wonderland, Santa is in front of the Harford County Courthouse on the Saturdays of November 28, December 5 and December 12, from 5 to 8 pm. Kids can also hand deliver a letter with their Christmas requests and look for the Snow Sisters while they are there.
Are there free Christmas events in Bel Air?

Yes. The Winter Wonderland Express train rides at Old Fields Park are free, the Christmas train garden at Main Street Tower is free and open to the public, and the carriage rides are complimentary. Signup for carriage rides is in person only at the Armory on the evening you wish to ride.
Is there a train ride in Bel Air?

Yes. The Winter Wonderland Express runs free train rides for the whole family at Old Fields Park, next to 138 N Bond Street, on Saturdays November 28, December 5 and December 12 from 5 to 8 pm. The Christmas in Bel Air site promises a lot of smiles and a little choo-choo cheer.
How long are the Bel Air lights on?

The downtown lights glow each night from November 28, 2026, to January 3, 2027. The extra events, such as live music, Santa and carriage rides, run on the Saturdays of November 28, December 5 and December 12, and Main Street is closed to vehicles on December 5 from 4 to 8 pm.
